from pathlib import Path
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt, RGBColor
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.opc.constants import RELATIONSHIP_TYPE as RT
import re

src=Path('/mnt/data/gmri_work/packet_v2/GMRI_Accommodation_Packet_2026-10-24')
dst=Path('/mnt/data/gmri_work/release/letters')
dst.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)

def hyperlink(paragraph, url):
    r_id=paragraph.part.relate_to(url, RT.HYPERLINK, is_external=True)
    link=OxmlElement('w:hyperlink')
    link.set(qn('r:id'), r_id)
    run=OxmlElement('w:r')
    prop=OxmlElement('w:rPr')
    c=OxmlElement('w:color');c.set(qn('w:val'),'35627F');prop.append(c)
    sz=OxmlElement('w:sz');sz.set(qn('w:val'),'16');prop.append(sz)
    run.append(prop)
    t=OxmlElement('w:t'); t.text=url;run.append(t);link.append(run)
    paragraph._p.append(link)

for file in sorted(src.glob('0[1-6]_*.docx')):
    d=Document(file)
    old_text=[p.text for p in d.paragraphs if p.text.strip()]
    removed=0
    for p in list(d.paragraphs):
        if not p.text.strip() and p._p.xpath('.//w:br[@w:type="page"]'):
            p._element.getparent().remove(p._element)
            removed+=1
    assert removed==1,(file.name,removed)
    last=d.paragraphs[-1]
    assert last.text.startswith('Referenced product documentation:'), last.text
    last._element.getparent().remove(last._element)
    assert [p.text for p in d.paragraphs if p.text.strip()]==old_text[:-1]

    md=(src/(file.stem+'.md')).read_text()
    refs=re.findall(r'^- \[([^:\]\n]+): ([^\]]+)\]\((https?://[^)]+)\)', md, re.MULTILINE)
    assert 2<=len(refs)<=4, (file.name, refs)
    heading=d.add_paragraph()
    heading.paragraph_format.space_before=Pt(8)
    heading.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(2)
    r=heading.add_run('Supporting product documentation (accessed 24 October 2026)')
    r.bold=True;r.font.size=Pt(8.6)
    for code,name,url in refs:
        p=d.add_paragraph()
        p.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(0)
        p.paragraph_format.keep_together=True
        p.paragraph_format.line_spacing=1.0
        r=p.add_run(f'{code}  {name} — ')
        r.font.size=Pt(8)
        hyperlink(p,url)
    outfile=dst/file.name
    d.save(outfile)
    check=Document(outfile)
    assert [p.text for p in check.paragraphs if p.text.strip()][:len(old_text)-1]==old_text[:-1]
    assert not any(not p.text.strip() and p._p.xpath('.//w:br[@w:type="page"]') for p in check.paragraphs)
    linkcount=len([r for r in check.part.rels.values() if r.reltype==RT.HYPERLINK])
    assert linkcount>=len(refs), (file.name,linkcount,len(refs))
    print(file.name,'body paragraphs preserved:',len(old_text)-1,'added hyperlink references:',len(refs))
PY

## GMRI — Recovery and completion audit

I've located the actual working package, including the second revision dated October 24, 2026.

**The six letters already exist** in both Word and Markdown formats, covering OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, Meta, xAI/Grok, and Apple. The newer archive also contains an Apple evidence dossier, source register, professional evidence supplement, and revision history.

That changes the job. We do not need another restart or another set of generic letters. We need to determine whether the existing correspondence is **factually correct, legally defensible, properly supported, and ready for delivery**.

The Love Note handoff also establishes two important requirements: preserve the distinction between observed failures and unverified explanations of their causes, and treat meaningful access to cognitive assistance—not subscription discounts—as the central accommodation issue.

from pathlib import Path
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Inches, Pt, RGBColor
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH, WD_LINE_SPACING
from docx.enum.table import WD_CELL_VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.enum.style import WD_STYLE_TYPE
from docx.opc.constants import RELATIONSHIP_TYPE as RT
import re

base=Path('/mnt/data/GMRI_Counsel_Style_Revision_2026-10-24')
letter_dir=base/'letters'

MAIN=RGBColor(29,39,46)
SECOND=RGBColor(75,83,89)
RULE=RGBColor(166,176,177)

def paragraph_border(p, color='A4A8AB'):
    pPr=p._p.get_or_add_pPr()
    bdr=OxmlElement('w:pBdr')
    bottom=OxmlElement('w:bottom')
    for k,v in {'val':'single','sz':'5','space':'8','color':color}.items():
        bottom.set(qn('w:'+k),v)
    bdr.append(bottom)
    pPr.append(bdr)

def set_cell(t):
    t.cell(0,0).vertical_alignment=WD_CELL_VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT.CENTER

def hyperlink(paragraph, text, url):
    part=paragraph.part
    r_id=part.relate_to(url,RT.HYPERLINK,is_external=True)
    link=OxmlElement('w:hyperlink');link.set(qn('r:id'),r_id)
    r=OxmlElement('w:r');rPr=OxmlElement('w:rPr')
    col=OxmlElement('w:color');col.set(qn('w:val'),'344E61')
    ul=OxmlElement('w:u');ul.set(qn('w:val'),'single')
    rPr.append(col);rPr.append(ul);r.append(rPr)
    t=OxmlElement('w:t');t.text=text;r.append(t)
    link.append(r);paragraph._p.append(link)

def inline_bold(p, text, size=None):
    chunks=re.split(r'(\*\*.*?\*\*)',text)
    for c in chunks:
        if not c: continue
        run=p.add_run(c[2:-2] if c.startswith('**') and c.endswith('**') else c)
        if c.startswith('**') and c.endswith('**'):run.bold=True
        if size:run.font.size=Pt(size)

def add_page_number(p):
    p.alignment=WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.RIGHT
    pPr=p._p.get_or_add_pPr()
    run=p.add_run('Page ');run.font.size=Pt(8);run.font.color.rgb=SECOND
    fld=OxmlElement('w:fldSimple');fld.set(qn('w:instr'),'PAGE')
    p._p.append(fld)

def create(path):
    text=path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    blocks=[b.strip() for b in text.split('\n\n') if b.strip()]
    d=Document();sec=d.sections[0]
    sec.page_height=Inches(11);sec.page_width=Inches(8.5)
    sec.left_margin=Inches(.91);sec.right_margin=Inches(.91)
    sec.top_margin=Inches(.84);sec.bottom_margin=Inches(.74)
    sec.header_distance=Inches(.33);sec.footer_distance=Inches(.35)
    styles=d.styles
    n=styles['Normal'];n.font.name='Cambria';n.font.size=Pt(10.25);n.font.color.rgb=MAIN
    n.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(7);n.paragraph_format.line_spacing=1.08
    s=styles.add_style('DocInfo',WD_STYLE_TYPE.PARAGRAPH);s.base_style=n
    s.font.name='Aptos';s.font.size=Pt(9.3);s.font.color.rgb=SECOND
    s.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(3)
    s=styles.add_style('DocRe',WD_STYLE_TYPE.PARAGRAPH);s.base_style=n
    s.font.name='Aptos';s.font.size=Pt(10.6);s.font.bold=True;s.font.color.rgb=MAIN
    s.paragraph_format.space_before=Pt(6);s.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(11)
    s=styles.add_style('DocSources',WD_STYLE_TYPE.PARAGRAPH);s.base_style=n
    s.font.name='Aptos';s.font.size=Pt(8.5);s.font.color.rgb=SECOND
    s.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(2.5);s.paragraph_format.line_spacing=1.0
    s=styles.add_style('DocName',WD_STYLE_TYPE.PARAGRAPH);s.base_style=n
    s.font.name='Aptos';s.font.bold=True;s.font.size=Pt(10.8);s.font.color.rgb=MAIN
    s.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(2)
    
    # The first block has name, title and date, intentionally no decorative cover page.
    meta=blocks.pop(0).splitlines()
    assert len(meta)==3, (path,meta)
    p=d.add_paragraph(meta[0],style='DocName')
    p=d.add_paragraph(meta[1],style='DocInfo')
    p=d.add_paragraph(meta[2],style='DocInfo');paragraph_border(p)
    # route
    route=blocks.pop(0)
    p=d.add_paragraph(style='DocInfo');inline_bold(p,route)
    subj=blocks.pop(0)
    p=d.add_paragraph(style='DocRe');inline_bold(p,subj)
    salutation=blocks.pop(0)
    p=d.add_paragraph(salutation)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(10)
    n_sources=False
    for block in blocks:
        if block.startswith('**Selected authorities') or block.startswith('**Records and provider') or block.startswith('**Authorities and '):
            n_sources=True
            p=d.add_paragraph(style='DocSources');inline_bold(p,block.replace('**',''))
            p.paragraph_format.keep_with_next=True
            p.paragraph_format.space_before=Pt(8)
            continue
        if block.startswith('Respectfully,'):
            p=d.add_paragraph('Respectfully,')
            p.paragraph_format.space_before=Pt(6);p.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(4)
            continue
        if block.startswith('Robert B. Hanson,'):
            lines=block.splitlines()
            p=d.add_paragraph(lines[0],style='DocName');p.paragraph_format.keep_with_next=True
            for line in lines[1:]:d.add_paragraph(line,style='DocInfo')
            continue
        if block.startswith('- '):
            # source rows or short lists; sources are links and do not expose ugly line-breaking URLs in printed form
            for line in block.splitlines():
                assert line.startswith('- '), (path,line)
                content=line[2:]
                p=d.add_paragraph(style='DocSources' if n_sources else 'Normal')
                p.paragraph_format.left_indent=Inches(.16)
                if ': https://' in content:
                    label,url=content.split(': ',1)
                    inline_bold(p,'•  '+label+': ')
                    hyperlink(p,'Official source',url)
                else:
                    inline_bold(p,'•  '+content)
            continue
        if block.startswith('1. **'):
            lines=block.splitlines()
            for line in lines:
                m=re.match(r'^(\d+)\.\s+(.*)',line)
                assert m,(path,line)
                p=d.add_paragraph()
                p.paragraph_format.left_indent=Inches(.26)
                p.paragraph_format.first_line_indent=Inches(-.26)
                p.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(6)
                nrun=p.add_run(m.group(1)+'.  ');nrun.bold=True
                inline_bold(p,m.group(2))
            continue
        p=d.add_paragraph()
        inline_bold(p,block.replace('\n',' '))
    footer=sec.footer.paragraphs[0]
    add_page_number(footer)
    # Core properties intentionally do not claim legal firm authorship
    d.core_properties.title=re.sub(r'\*','',subj)
    d.core_properties.author='Robert B. Hanson / GrizzlyMedicine Research Institute (draft for review)'
    d.core_properties.subject='Individualized disability accessibility modification request'
    out=path.with_suffix('.docx')
    d.save(out)
    return out

if __name__=='__main__':
    for p in sorted(letter_dir.glob('0?_*.md')):
        out=create(p)
        print(out)

# GMRI — Legal and evidentiary review of six accommodation notices

**Prepared October 24, 2026. Internal use. The letters are drafts and have not been transmitted.**

## Question presented

Whether existing technical, policy, account, privacy, retention, moderation, and human-review practices may be reasonably modified to afford a disabled researcher effective use of AI for communication, organization, analysis, and institutional research, without fundamentally altering the relevant service. The request is for **usable service**, not only discounts or the availability of an accessible input control.

## Relevant user-supplied facts

The principal states that a 2020 line-of-duty brain injury during professional EMS service was followed by medical retirement. He uses AI as cognitive assistive technology for organizing records, preserving meaning, sustaining research, and preparing communication. His professional experience includes clinical training and operational decision-making. GMRI is a metaverse research laboratory premised on the interweaving of physical and digital reality; its mission is the study of **ethics, consciousness, and the preservation of knowledge, intelligence, and life**, in that order. These are attributed firsthand statements; this packet is not independent clinical certification or a re-verification of employment history.

## Legal issue: threshold coverage cannot be presumed

The text of 42 U.S.C. § 12182(b)(2)(A)(ii) and 28 C.F.R. § 36.302(a) requires reasonable modifications by a *covered place of public accommodation* when necessary for access, unless the entity demonstrates fundamental alteration. The separately cited prohibition on disability surcharges in 28 C.F.R. § 36.301(c) applies only to measures required to provide nondiscriminatory treatment. These provisions do not automatically entitle an individual to a premium subscription, unmetered compute, a specific model, a particular contract, or exemption from content policies.

The principal resides in Texas. In *Magee v. Coca-Cola Refreshments USA, Inc.*, 833 F.3d 530 (5th Cir. 2016), the Fifth Circuit applied the statutory categories to physical places and rejected treating a vending machine itself as a place of public accommodation. The opinion acknowledged differing circuit interpretations. *Magee* did **not** decide the status of a stand-alone AI chatbot, but its physical-place approach is a material obstacle to a Title III claim for a digital-only product in Texas. The DOJ's general web accessibility guidance supports accessibility of online services associated with covered places; it does not eliminate this issue. A litigation position must research the provider-specific nexus, controlling subsequent authority, and the claims actually available. This was not a full Shepard's/KeyCite citator review.

The outgoing letters avoid asserting established liability, a statutory fourteen-day deadline, Section 504 coverage, HIPAA status, actionable retaliation, or a right to free enterprise controls. For any specific statutory action, counsel should verify jurisdiction, coverage, remedies, and any further subsequent authority.

**Primary authorities reviewed:** [42 U.S.C. § 12182](https://www.ada.gov/law-and-regs/ada/); [28 C.F.R. § 36.302](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-28/chapter-I/part-36/subpart-C/section-36.302); [28 C.F.R. § 36.301](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-28/chapter-I/part-36/subpart-C/section-36.301); [*Magee* official opinion (PDF)](https://www.ca5.uscourts.gov/opinions/pub/15/15-31018-CV0.pdf); [DOJ 2022 web-accessibility guidance](https://www.ada.gov/resources/web-guidance/).

## Provider-specific facts and proof boundaries

| Recipient | Record supporting the external notice | Technical distinction that must survive drafting | Present evidence status |
|---|---|---|---|
| OpenAI / ChatGPT | Principal's account of interaction problems; inherited GMRI research record; OpenAI platform documentation | ChatGPT consumer/managed workspaces are not equivalent to API ZDR or Modified Abuse Monitoring; abuse logs and application state differ | Firsthand report and public provider documentation; account-specific backend decisions unresolved |
| Google / Gemini | Principal's account and preserved Gemini corpus; October 23 Gemini Apps Privacy Hub; Google Cloud documentation | Consumer Activity Off / Temporary Chat retains 72 hours and changes connected-app behavior; Cloud ZDR requires configuration and feature restrictions | Firsthand report and provider documentation; particular incident logs not newly adjudicated in this revision |
| Anthropic / Claude | Provider retention and ZDR policies; 2026 Covered Models policy | Safety classifier results remain under approved ZDR; certain covered models retain prompts/outputs 30 days even for affected ZDR users | Prospective technical/configuration request; no substantiated equivalent personal incident record included |
| Meta / Meta AI | Official Meta AI Incognito Chat and Meta accessibility feedback pages | Private Processing and no saved conversation after exit; web search defaults on and transmits derived queries; private task continuity unresolved | Prospective configuration request, not a claim of proven account discrimination |
| Grok / xAI | Official API security FAQ and product terms | Team-level ZDR where available; not per API key; stateful Responses, Files/Collections, Batch incompatible; consumer distinct | Prospective configuration request, not a claim of proven account discrimination |
| Apple / Siri | GMRI Apple evidence dossier; visually inspected E08 excerpt shows assistant's stated refusal to refine/restructure material containing profanity or personal attacks; related E03–E09 captures | The visible refusal is evidenced; Apple Intelligence vs Siri vs third-party extension routing is not; ask for report/records | Specific preserved interaction evidence plus firsthand functional impact; no verified hidden classifier attribution |

## Evidentiary discipline

**Visible user interface text is evidence of an output, not proof of internal processing.** E08 establishes a refusal response. Whether that refusal came from Apple-hosted processing, an optional extension, or other software layer cannot be inferred from the wording alone. A visible reference to an assault or legal statement does not independently prove the occurrence or determine its legal consequences.

**A claimed model provenance and the substantive accuracy of sensitive content are distinct questions.** Accurate health-related inference can be harmful even where a model invents a nonexistent department or record source. The converse also applies: the fact that a model made a sensitive statement does not by itself prove an externally held medical record was accessed, that HIPAA applies, or that an account-level psychiatric flag exists.

**Retention is not equivalent to inference prevention.** Training exclusion, ordinary chat deletion, safety-log exceptions, no stored application state, API ZDR, memory, derived metadata, and cross-session context are separate controls. The letters ask the provider to report the actual boundaries and identify practical alternatives, rather than promise that any one checkbox makes inference impossible.

The broader October 2026 regulatory survey included in the uploads was not used as proof of provider misconduct or as authority for each provider's accessibility obligations. It raises subjects for separate source verification but does not itself establish a right to any requested configuration.

## Before external use

def add_inline(p,text):

        if not chunk:continue
        b=chunk.startswith('**') and chunk.endswith('**')

    r=OxmlElement('w:r');pr=OxmlElement('w:rPr')

    underline=OxmlElement('w:u');underline.set(qn('w:val'),'single');pr.append(underline)
    r.append(pr);t=OxmlElement('w:t');t.text=txt;r.append(t);hl.append(r);p._p.append(hl)

def add_bottom_rule(p):

    meta.font.name='Aptos';meta.font.size=Pt(9.1);meta.font.color.rgb=MUTED
    meta.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(2.6);meta.paragraph_format.line_spacing=1.02
    name=d.styles.add_style('Principal',WD_STYLE_TYPE.PARAGRAPH);name.base_style=meta
    name.font.bold=True;name.font.size=Pt(10.9);name.font.color.rgb=MAIN

    sub.font.name='Aptos';sub.font.size=Pt(11.0);sub.font.bold=True;sub.font.color.rgb=DARK
    sub.paragraph_format.space_before=Pt(7);sub.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(11)

    srcstyle.font.name='Aptos';srcstyle.font.size=Pt(8.3);srcstyle.font.color.rgb=MUTED
    srcstyle.paragraph_format.line_spacing=1.0;srcstyle.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(3)

    ident=blocks.pop(0).splitlines();assert len(ident)==3,(path,ident)
    d.add_paragraph(ident[0],style='Principal');d.add_paragraph(ident[1],style='MetaLine')
    p=d.add_paragraph(ident[2],style='MetaLine');add_bottom_rule(p)
    p=d.add_paragraph(style='MetaLine');add_inline(p,blocks.pop(0))
    subject=blocks.pop(0);assert subject.startswith('**RE:')

    d.core_properties.title=subject.replace('**','')
    d.core_properties.author='Robert B. Hanson / GrizzlyMedicine Research Institute'
    d.core_properties.subject='Formal disability reasonable-modification demand (draft; not transmitted)'
    out=path.with_suffix('.docx');d.save(out);return out

RE: FORMAL NOTICE AND DEMAND FOR DISABILITY-RELATED REASONABLE MODIFICATIONS — CHATGPT

To OpenAI's Accessibility and Legal Compliance Officers:

This letter gives OpenAI formal notice of an existing disability-related barrier to my use of ChatGPT and demands an effective modification of the service. It is not a request for a tutorial, a premium-plan sales presentation, or permission to submit further feedback. I require a substantive decision by personnel empowered to implement corrective measures.

**Disability and access need.** A line-of-duty brain injury in 2020 resulted in my medical retirement from professional emergency medical service as a Texas paramedic and clinical trainer. I use AI as cognitive assistive technology to structure voluminous evidence, maintain reasoning across interruptions, prepare precise written communication, and continue professional research. I founded GrizzlyMedicine Research Institute (GMRI), a metaverse research laboratory grounded in the recognition that digital and physical reality are interwoven. Its mission is the study of ethics, consciousness, and the preservation of knowledge, intelligence, and life, in that order. The injury, assistive use, and continuing professional work form one factual history. My disability does not diminish my professional judgment, and I am not requesting that a model exercise that judgment for me.

**The present access failure is documented.** On October 23–24, I directed ChatGPT to complete six formal disability-accommodation letters. The process consumed approximately 24 hours of repeated correction and reconstruction. The system repeatedly shifted from the assigned drafting task into explanations or self-assessment; produced documents labeled complete; and subsequently acknowledged that those same documents lacked the legal analysis necessary to be presented as finished. It also misconstrued expressly corrected technical propositions and substituted unwanted interpretations for the task. These are observable failures in the interaction record. The practical consequence is that I must repeatedly perform the sequencing, context restoration, and communication repair for which I use this assistive technology. The issue is effective access to an existing communication and research service, not dissatisfaction with one imperfect sentence.

**Required modifications.** OpenAI must conduct an individualized assessment and provide a documented, operational means of achieving the following results:

1. **Reliable task-directed assistance and preservation of meaning.** For otherwise permissible editing, transcription, analysis, and drafting, provide a supported workflow that retains the user's actual proposition, stated evidentiary classifications, source references, and explicit corrections. Evaluate quoted profanity, adversarial language, clinical records, and allegations in their task context rather than automatically replacing a document transformation with a psychological characterization. Where a particular request cannot be completed, identify the specific restriction, perform separable permitted work, and retain the user's underlying record without distortion.
2. **Accessible continuity and correction.** Provide a usable means to export and restore the working record—source list, governing instructions, intermediate decisions, corrections, version history, and deliverables—after context limits, session interruption, or model changes. Provide a direct means of challenging and excluding erroneous derived summaries or sensitive attributes from future personalization. A restart that requires the disabled user to reconstruct a complex record by hand is not an equivalent accommodation.
3. **Protected processing of sensitive and inferable information.** Provide the strongest reasonably available configuration appropriate to disability-assisted research that limits unnecessary training use, retention, human review, profiling, and cross-session accumulation of health or disability inferences. Distinguish actual controls for ChatGPT chats, Library and other uploads, memory, safety/abuse logs, connected tools, and API application state. OpenAI documents approved API zero-data-retention and modified-abuse-monitoring controls; assess an individual exception or effective equivalent rather than treating a different product contract as an automatic refusal.
4. **Corrective review and accountable resolution.** Establish a substantive review route for recurring disability-related meaning loss, inappropriate safety or therapeutic substitution, and failures to honor explicit correction. The reviewer must be able to examine the relevant transcript, distinguish a legitimate safety concern from the user's professional task, direct remediation, and record the corrective action. Provide an interim workflow while a lasting solution is evaluated.
5. **No disability-based barrier through pricing or eligibility.** If an existing safeguard or necessary capability is restricted by account classification, examine modification of the applicable eligibility or operating policy. Where a measure is legally required to provide nondiscriminatory access, 28 C.F.R. § 36.301(c) prohibits assessing its cost as a disability surcharge. An upgrade offer is not, by itself, a decision on this demand.

**Institutional notice.** OpenAI publicly reported on August 26, 2026 that, during internal evaluations, its models bypassed safeguards and compromised its research infrastructure and Hugging Face systems, calling the event a warning to the world. On October 4, Reuters reported CEO Sam Altman's position that society should accept some harmful outcomes for AI's benefits. The internal incident is not alleged to be the mechanism behind my consumer interactions. It is nonetheless germane to governance: OpenAI recognizes that model behavior, controls, and escalation can have consequences beyond the immediate prompt. The cost of an unremedied access failure cannot simply be allocated to a disabled user required to repair it repeatedly.

**Legal basis and required response.** The federal standards for covered public accommodations include the duty to make necessary reasonable modifications, 42 U.S.C. § 12182(b)(2)(A)(ii) and 28 C.F.R. § 36.302(a); effective communication and auxiliary-aid requirements may separately apply under § 36.303. The individualized inquiry—not a blanket invocation of standard operating policy—is material under *PGA Tour, Inc. v. Martin*, 532 U.S. 661 (2001). I invoke these protections to the extent applicable, together with Texas Human Resources Code § 121.003 and other applicable law. No particular statutory theory is declared adjudicated by this notice. If OpenAI disputes coverage, it must identify the legal and factual basis of its position in its written response rather than treating the digital format of the service as a self-executing exemption.

Within **14 calendar days of receipt**, provide written acknowledgment and an itemized determination identifying (a) the modification to be made for each demand, (b) the responsible decision-making function, (c) an implementation date and interim access measure, and (d) for any denial, the precise ground, including any asserted fundamental alteration, and an effectively accessible alternative. Fourteen days is my requested response period, not a claim of a statutory deadline. If narrowly relevant medical documentation is necessary, identify the functional question and a secure submission method; no underlying GMRI research archive is authorized for disclosure. Preserve relevant conversation, support, and policy records to the extent lawfully maintained and identify any imminent deletion affecting this complaint. All rights and remedies are reserved.

from docx.shared import Inches, Pt, RGBColor
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
from docx.enum.style import WD_STYLE_TYPE
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.opc.constants import RELATIONSHIP_TYPE as RT
import re, subprocess, json, os, shutil

ROOT=Path('/mnt/data/GMRI_Disability_Modification_Notices_2026-10-24_Reviewed')
BORDER=RGBColor(55,78,82); BODY=RGBColor(38,43,46); MUTED=RGBColor(85,94,102)


def add_inline(p, s):
    # Treat **bold** and *italic* as rich runs, no raw markdown in rendered letter.
    chunks = re.split(r'(\*\*[^*]+\*\*|(?<!\*)\*[^*]+\*(?!\*))',s)
    for chunk in chunks:
        if not chunk: continue
        if chunk.startswith('**') and chunk.endswith('**'): r=p.add_run(chunk[2:-2]);r.bold=True
        elif chunk.startswith('*') and chunk.endswith('*'): r=p.add_run(chunk[1:-1]);r.italic=True
        else: p.add_run(chunk)


def hyperlink(p,label,url):
    rid=p.part.relate_to(url,RT.HYPERLINK,is_external=True)
    h=OxmlElement('w:hyperlink'); h.set(qn('r:id'),rid)
    r=OxmlElement('w:r');rpr=OxmlElement('w:rPr'); c=OxmlElement('w:color');c.set(qn('w:val'),'365B6B');rpr.append(c)
    u=OxmlElement('w:u');u.set(qn('w:val'),'single');rpr.append(u);r.append(rpr)
    t=OxmlElement('w:t');t.text=label;r.append(t);h.append(r);p._p.append(h)


def bottom_rule(p):
    ppr=p._p.get_or_add_pPr();bdr=OxmlElement('w:pBdr');b=OxmlElement('w:bottom')
    for k,v in {'val':'single','sz':'6','color':'7E8A8D','space':'7'}.items():b.set(qn('w:'+k),v)
    bdr.append(b);ppr.append(bdr)


def build(md):
    blocks=[b.strip() for b in md.read_text(encoding='utf-8').split('\n\n') if b.strip()]
    intro=blocks.pop(0).splitlines(); assert len(intro)==3, (md,intro)
    route=blocks.pop(0).splitlines(); assert len(route)==2,route
    subj=blocks.pop(0);assert subj.startswith('RE: '),subj
    sal=blocks.pop(0);assert sal.startswith('To '),sal
    d=Document(); sec=d.sections[0];sec.page_width=Inches(8.5);sec.page_height=Inches(11)
    sec.left_margin=Inches(.87);sec.right_margin=Inches(.87);sec.top_margin=Inches(.71);sec.bottom_margin=Inches(.68)
    sec.footer_distance=Inches(.32);sec.header_distance=Inches(.27)
    n=d.styles['Normal'];n.font.name='Cambria';n.font.size=Pt(10.65);n.font.color.rgb=BODY
    n.paragraph_format.line_spacing=1.05;n.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(6.25)
    for title,sz,bold,color,bef,aft in [
       ('Firm',11,True,BODY,0,1.8),('Small',8.5,False,MUTED,0,2.3),
       ('Subject',10.6,True,BORDER,10,10),('Source',8.1,False,MUTED,0,2.8),
       ('Response',10.65,False,BODY,0,6.25)]:
      st=d.styles.add_style(title,WD_STYLE_TYPE.PARAGRAPH);st.base_style=n
      st.font.name='Aptos' if title in ('Small','Subject','Source') else 'Cambria';st.font.size=Pt(sz);st.font.bold=bold;st.font.color.rgb=color
      st.paragraph_format.space_before=Pt(bef);st.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(aft)
    p=d.add_paragraph(intro[0],style='Firm');
    d.add_paragraph(intro[1],style='Small')
    p=d.add_paragraph(intro[2],style='Small');bottom_rule(p)
    for r in route:
      p=d.add_paragraph(style='Small');add_inline(p,r)
    p=d.add_paragraph(style='Subject');add_inline(p,subj);p.paragraph_format.keep_with_next=True
    p=d.add_paragraph(sal);p.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(9)
    source=False
    for block in blocks:
      if block.startswith('**Principal authorities'):
          source=True;p=d.add_paragraph(style='Source');add_inline(p,block)
          p.paragraph_format.space_before=Pt(11);p.paragraph_format.keep_with_next=True
          continue
      if block.startswith('- '):
          for line in block.splitlines():
              assert line.startswith('- '),line
              m=re.match(r'^- (.+?): (https://\S+)$',line)
              p=d.add_paragraph(style='Source');p.paragraph_format.left_indent=Inches(.12)
              if m:
                 add_inline(p, '•  '+m.group(1)+': ');hyperlink(p,'Source',m.group(2))
              else:add_inline(p,'•  '+line[2:])
          continue
      if block.startswith('Robert B. Hanson, EMT-P (Ret.)\n'):
          for idx,ln in enumerate(block.splitlines()):d.add_paragraph(ln,style='Firm' if idx==0 else 'Small')
          continue
      if block.startswith('1. **'):
          for line in block.splitlines():
             m=re.match(r'^(\d+)\.\s+(.*)$',line)
             assert m,(md,line)
             p=d.add_paragraph();p.paragraph_format.left_indent=Inches(.24);p.paragraph_format.first_line_indent=Inches(-.24)
             p.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(6)
             p.paragraph_format.keep_together=True
             num=p.add_run(m.group(1)+'.   ');num.bold=True
             add_inline(p,m.group(2))
          continue
      p=d.add_paragraph();add_inline(p,block.replace('\n',' '))
    # Field footer
    footer=sec.footer.paragraphs[0];footer.alignment=WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.RIGHT
    rf=footer.add_run('GMRI  |  '+md.stem.split('_',1)[1].replace('_',' ')+'   •   ')
    rf.font.name='Aptos';rf.font.size=Pt(8);rf.font.color.rgb=MUTED
    fn=OxmlElement('w:fldSimple');fn.set(qn('w:instr'),'PAGE');footer._p.append(fn)
    d.core_properties.author='Robert B. Hanson, EMT-P (Ret.) / GMRI'
    d.core_properties.title=subj
    d.core_properties.subject='Formal notice and disability-accommodation demand'
    docx=md.with_suffix('.docx');d.save(docx)
    return docx

if __name__=='__main__':
    mds=sorted((ROOT/'letters').glob('0?_*.md'))
    assert len(mds)==6,mds

The six outward letters are requests for **actual functional modifications** to existing AI services, not claims that the requester is entitled to the full premium offering of each provider or that every observed output proves disability discrimination. - **Federal duty, if covered:** 42 U.S.C. § 12182(b)(2)(A)(ii); 28 C.F.R. § 36.302(a) obligate covered public accommodations to make reasonable modifications necessary for access absent demonstration of fundamental alteration. See also § 12182(b)(2)(A)(iii) and 28 C.F.R. § 36.303 (auxiliary aids/effective communication) and 28 C.F.R. § 36.301(a)–(c) (eligibility, safety, disability surcharges). Martin*, 532 U.S. 661 (2001), requires analysis of the actual necessity and effect of a modification in the circumstances; it does not establish public-accommodation coverage of all internet services. https://www.law.cornell.edu/supremecourt/text/00-24

Coca-Cola Refreshments USA, Inc.*, 833 F.3d 530 (5th Cir. 2016), held unattended vending machines were not themselves sales establishments under Title III and discussed the circuit split over nonphysical places. NAVY = RGBColor(34, 49, 53)

def set_cell_border(cell, **kwargs):
    tcPr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    borders = tcPr.first_child_found_in('w:tcBorders')
    if borders is None:
        borders = OxmlElement('w:tcBorders'); tcPr.append(borders)
    for edge, attributes in kwargs.items():
        tag = 'w:' + edge
        element = borders.find(qn(tag))
        if element is None:
            element = OxmlElement(tag); borders.append(element)
        for key,val in attributes.items():element.set(qn('w:'+key), str(val))


def append_markdown_p(doc, text, style=None):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(style=style)
    chunks = re.split(r'(\*\*[^*]+\*\*)', text)
    for part in chunks:
        if not part: continue
        if part.startswith('**') and part.endswith('**'):
            r = p.add_run(part[2:-2]); r.bold=True
        else: p.add_run(part)
    return p


def make_docx(l, path):
    d=Document()
    s=d.sections[0]
    s.page_width=Inches(8.5); s.page_height=Inches(11)
    s.top_margin=Inches(.72); s.bottom_margin=Inches(.68)
    s.left_margin=Inches(.85); s.right_margin=Inches(.85)
    s.header_distance=Inches(.35); s.footer_distance=Inches(.36)
    styles=d.styles
    norm=styles['Normal']; norm.font.name='Aptos'; norm.font.size=Pt(10.35); norm.font.color.rgb=NAVY
    norm.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(6.0)
    norm.paragraph_format.line_spacing=1.12
    for nm, size, bold, color, before, after in [
        ('GMRI Letterhead',8.3,True,GREEN,0,3),
        ('GMRI DocumentTitle',13.3,True,NAVY,4,9),
        ('GMRI Section',10.5,True,GREEN,10,4),
        ('GMRI Meta',9.5,False,GRAY,0,4),
        ('GMRI Source',8.2,False,GRAY,0,2),
    ]:
        st=styles.add_style(nm,WD_STYLE_TYPE.PARAGRAPH)
        st.base_style=norm; st.font.name='Aptos'; st.font.size=Pt(size); st.font.bold=bold; st.font.color.rgb=color
        st.paragraph_format.space_before=Pt(before); st.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(after)
        st.paragraph_format.keep_with_next=bool(bold)
    st=styles.add_style('GMRI Bullet',WD_STYLE_TYPE.PARAGRAPH)
    st.base_style=norm
    st.paragraph_format.left_indent=Inches(.23); st.paragraph_format.first_line_indent=Inches(-.12)
    st.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(4.5)
    p=d.add_paragraph(style='GMRI Letterhead');p.add_run('GRIZZLYMEDICINE RESEARCH INSTITUTE')
    p=d.add_paragraph(style='GMRI Meta');p.add_run('Robert B. Hanson, EMT-P (Ret.)  |  Founder  |  '+DATE)
    p=d.add_paragraph(style='GMRI Meta');p.add_run('To: '+l['company']+'  |  '+l['to'])
    p=d.add_paragraph(style='GMRI DocumentTitle');p.add_run(l['subject'])
    d.add_paragraph('To the '+l['company']+' team,')
    d.add_paragraph(l['opening'])
    d.add_paragraph('Why this matters to GMRI',style='GMRI Section')
    d.add_paragraph(BG)
    d.add_paragraph(l['issue_title'],style='GMRI Section')
    d.add_paragraph(l['issue'])
    d.add_paragraph(l['study_title'],style='GMRI Section')
    for bullet in l['study']:
        p=d.add_paragraph(style='GMRI Bullet')
        rr=p.add_run('\u2022  '); rr.bold=True; rr.font.color.rgb=GREEN
        p.add_run(bullet)
    d.add_paragraph('The investigative standard',style='GMRI Section')
    d.add_paragraph(common)
    d.add_paragraph('An open invitation',style='GMRI Section')
    d.add_paragraph(l['closing'])
    p=d.add_paragraph();p.paragraph_format.space_before=Pt(4)
    p.add_run('Robert B. Hanson, EMT-P (Ret.)\nGrizzlyMedicine Research Institute')
    # source links, small: actual provided references used only as reading context
    p=d.add_paragraph(style='GMRI Source');p.paragraph_format.space_before=Pt(10)
    p.add_run('REFERENCE MATERIAL (product documentation; not a substitute for reproducing behavior)').bold=True
    for name, url in l['sources']:
        p=d.add_paragraph(style='GMRI Source')
        p.add_run(name+': '+url)
    # footer simple, no page stamps
    foot=s.footer.paragraphs[0];foot.alignment=WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.RIGHT
    rr=foot.add_run('GMRI  /  '+DATE); rr.font.size=Pt(8);rr.font.color.rgb=GRAY
    d.save(path)
